verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents an AI Assistant that turns a prompt, link, or file into a finished video. It also documents an MCP integration for creating and finding videos from Claude and ChatGPT without calling the API, which covers natural-language operation of the core workflow. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands extend beyond creating and finding videos (e.g., editing, translation, or workspace management by prompt), MCP tool depth and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
